name: @ss-node/ss-system
description: Smart SCADA System Management Library - Health, Config, Backup, Monitor, Logs

scripts.build: tsc && npm run copy:templates && npm run copy:restarter
scripts.copy:templates: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'data\templates') { Copy-Item -Path 'data\templates\*' -Destination 'dist\data\templates\' -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'Templates copied to dist/data/templates' } else { Write-Host 'data/templates not found, skipping copy' }"
scripts.copy:restarter: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path 'dist\restart')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'dist\restart' -Force | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path 'src\restart\restarter.js' -Destination 'dist\restart\restarter.js' -Force; Write-Host 'Restarter script copied to dist/restart/restarter.js'"
